Name: pathfind
Description: Plan a route to treasure: swift (shortest, default), get_coins (greedy coins), score_aware (bounded reward detours with a time reserve). Return the path from successful results; never treat error responses as paths.

game_map.Description: JSON encoded navigation map object containing grid, playerStart, defaults (timeLimit or time, lives and scoring bonuses), and tileOverrides (points/damage only). Pass the complete navigation_map object unchanged. Legacy grids are accepted for swift/get_coins only; score_aware requires full metadata. No questions or expected answers.

start_pos.Description: JSON encoded [row, col] using zero-based coordinates; map playerStart takes precedence.

strategy.Description: swift, get_coins, or score_aware. Use score_aware only when explicitly requested. Default swift.

planning.Description: Optional score_aware settings. Omit for tested defaults; only use values explicitly requested. Do not override the map time limit.

reserveSeconds.Description: Time reserved for finishing uncertainty; default max(10 seconds, 20% of map time limit).

maxExtraMoves.Description: Extra moves beyond shortest safe route, 0 to 60; default 20.
